status: 초안 — 페이지에서 쓰지 않는다. 연방 Child Tax Credit·Credit for Other Dependents·Additional Child Tax Credit(26 U.S.C. 24, Schedule 8812) 금액 계산만, 주(州) child tax credit 은 다루지 않음(us.md 주의). 법조문·2025·2026 금액·Schedule 8812 (2025) 줄 순서는 원문 확인(2026-10-23), 남은 미확인 없음
note: CTC·ODC 는 비환급(세액 한도 = Credit Limit Worksheet A), ACTC 만 환급형. 2026 Schedule 8812·지침은 아직 안 나옴 — 2026 결과는 Rev. Proc. 2025-32 §3.05 금액에 Schedule 8812 (2025) 줄 순서를 적용한 값이라, 페이지는 'Rev. Proc. 2025-32 amounts with the 2025 Schedule 8812 method' 를 밝히고 2026 서식이 나오면(2026 말~2027 초) 줄 번호·금액을 다시 대조한다. Pub 972 는 2021 부터 폐지(Schedule 8812 지침이 유일한 출처) — 공식 숫자 예시는 없어 anchorTests 는 서식 줄 손계산. 세액(Form 1040 line 18 − Schedule 3 감면)은 계산하지 않고 사용자가 입력한다(세율표·표준공제 검증은 별도 일). 자격 판정(17세 미만·SSN·관계·거주·부양가족)은 계산하지 않고 원문 안내만. 2026 서식이 나오면 줄 번호·Part II-B 기준(3 × $1,700 = $5,100 예상)·Credit Limit Worksheet A 의 Schedule 3 줄 목록을 대조한다(EITC 의 2026 EIC Table 과 같은 처리 — 미확인이 아니라 공식 금액 + 2025 서식 방법으로 밝힘).

sources.label: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (2026 inflation adjustments) §2.03·§3.05
sources.quote: §2.03 the OBBBA amends § 24(h)(2) to provide that the maximum amount of child tax credit is $2,200 for any taxable year beginning in 2025. This amount is adjusted for inflation for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2025. §3.05 (1) For taxable years beginning in 2026, the maximum amount of the credit allowed under § 24(a) is $2,200. (2) … the amount used in § 24(d)(1)(A) to determine the amount of the credit under § 24 that may be refundable is $1,700.

sources.quote: For taxable years beginning in 2025, the amount used in § 24(d)(1)(A) to determine the amount of credit under § 24 that may be refundable is $1,700.

sources.label: IRS Child Tax Credit (Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 21-Sep-2026)
sources.quote: to be a qualifying child for the 2025 tax year, your child generally must: Be under 17 at the end of the tax year … The Child Tax Credit is worth up to $2,200 per qualifying child. … Additional Child Tax Credit, up to $1,700 per qualifying child … You must have earned income of at least $2,500 to be eligible for the ACTC. … not more than $200,000 ($400,000 if filing a joint return) … ODC … The maximum credit amount is $500 for each dependent … the IRS cannot issue these refunds before mid-February

sources.label: Instructions for Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) 2025 — What's New·Limits on the CTC and ODC·Credit Limit Worksheet A·Earned Income Chart
sources.quote: Beginning in tax year 2025, you must have a valid SSN to claim the CTC or ACTC. If you are filing a joint return, only one filer must have a valid SSN … The maximum amount of CTC for each qualifying child increased to $2,200. … ACTC amount … $1,700. … If the amount is zero, you cannot take either credit because there is no tax to reduce … you cannot take the ACTC if you are only claiming the ODC … Credit Limit Worksheet A: 1. line 18 of your Form 1040 … 2. Schedule 3, lines 1, 2, 3, 4, 5b, 6d, 6f, 6l, 6m … 5. Subtract line 4 [Worksheet B] from line 3 … If you file Form 2555, you cannot claim the additional child tax credit

sources.label: Publication 972 (obsolete notice)
sources.quote: Publication 972, Child Tax Credit, is obsolete … We revised Schedule 8812 … to be the sole source for figuring and reporting the child tax credit (CTC) and credit for other dependents (ODC).

sources.label: Instructions for Form 1040 (2025) — Rounding Off to Whole Dollars
sources.quote: You can round off cents to whole dollars on your return and schedules. If you do round to whole dollars, you must round all amounts. To round, drop amounts under 50 cents and increase amounts from 50 to 99 cents to the next dollar.
